Their stories are celebrated while we appropriate their regality, elegance and grace to adorn our company logos, be our sporting mascots and represent our families on crests. Then there's the other animals, the aesthetic outsiders we don't consider cute or cuddly. The critters we tend to laugh at or revile simply because they don't fit into what we deem as beautiful.

programme.title: Hunters Of The Reef - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Tropical coral reefs are the picture of colorful, light-dappled tranquility – but that’s a scuba diver’s perspective. To the scaly and gilled inhabitants, it’s a fish-eat-fish environment ruled by pods of dolphins who prowl the area at mealtimes while everyone else runs for cover. Incredible weapons, camouflage, venomous defenses and exceptional strategies have evolved among the smaller hunters in constant competition.

programme.title: World's Biggest Mako - Ep. 1
programme.desc: A team of scientists and a cinematographer searched the waters north of New Zealand to find giant mako. With the help of a local fisherman, who has worked this stretch of ocean for decades, they encounter a series of increasingly large mako sharks. While endangered elsewhere on the planet, this team discovers a population of mako that might be making a comeback.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Moving from turtles of the Palawan coast to the unique National Marine Park at Tubbataha, to meet giants, whale sharks and manta rays. We also see how people can mediate between people and wildlife as we join a snake hunting team catching and translocating a deadly Samar cobra.

programme.title: Big Cat Planet - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Big cats may seem like the ultimate wildlife cliche, but they’re locked in a global battle for survival. Powerful and dangerous, they now clash with humans more than ever. This sweeping safari reveals their resilience and adaptability. Cheetahs hunt from cars, jaguars stalk prey underwater and around boats, and India’s lions prowl city streets.

programme.title: Built To Survive T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin heads into the constant heat, humidity and rainfall of the Australian rainforests to find out what it takes to be “Built to Survive.” In the leafy canopy, Phil encounters the elusive tree kangaroo and its young joey, as well as Australia’s largest snake, the lethal scrub python. On the forest floor, the colorful cassowary acts as the rainforest’s gardener.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: It's monsoon season in Dogtown. Scarlett and her family hurry to reinforce their burrow before the flooding begins, but deal with unexpected guests right before the storm arrives.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Property disputes are settled a little differently in Dogtown. In search of first burrows on their own, Pelt and Digit come up against some unexpected challenges from Badgers and Alpha dogs protecting their territory.

programme.title: Predator V Prey T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: A forensic look at how leopards hunt prey both large and small, offering a new perspective on the way these silent killers stalk and ambush everything from impala to wildebeest and catfish to storks. A female leopard deploys stealth, strength and agility to take down prey on land, in water and from the air.

programme.title: American Amazon T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Take a journey into the secret wilderness of North America. Under the spell of legendary Southern waterways, follow the pulse of water as it tumbles from precipitous Appalachian highlands, slackens at the shoals of the fall line, floods across vast deltas, and reunites with the wild ocean. It’s an immersive encounter with stunning wildlife, up-close natural history, and surprising revelations from source to sea.

programme.title: Predator V Prey T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: A forensic look at how lions hunt large prey like buffalo and zebra, offering new perspectives on the way these predators stalk, chase and kill. A lone lioness relies on cunning to feed her newborn cubs, whilst a fearless pride tries to take down the biggest prey of all, a giant African elephant. .

programme.title: Predator V Prey T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: A forensic look at how leopards hunt prey both large and small, offering a new perspective on the way these silent killers stalk and ambush everything from impala to wildebeest and catfish to storks. A female leopard deploys stealth, strength and agility to take down prey on land, in water and from the air.

programme.title: American Amazon T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Take a journey into the secret wilderness of North America. Under the spell of legendary Southern waterways, follow the pulse of water as it tumbles from precipitous Appalachian highlands, slackens at the shoals of the fall line, floods across vast deltas, and reunites with the wild ocean. It’s an immersive encounter with stunning wildlife, up-close natural history, and surprising revelations from source to sea.

programme.title: The Living Edens T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Life and death are close companions in an Eden called Costa Rica. Nestled in the tropics of Central America, Costa Rica calls itself the land of “Pura Vida” – pure life. In a phenomenon known as the “Arribada”, the arrival, olive ridley sea turtles migrate annually in massive numbers while troops of capuchin, squirrel, howler monkeys and resplendent quetzals forage in the canopy above.

programme.title: United States Of Animals: Compilation T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: In the United States, some of the coolest migrations happen closer than you think, many right in your own backyard. From sandhill cranes in Nebraska to monarch butterflies in California, animals pack their bags and travel every year to settle in new homes, and some migrations may be in your hometown. This field guide is guaranteed to mark the spot where you can experience some amazing migrations.

programme.title: Predator V Prey T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: A forensic look at how lions hunt large prey like buffalo and zebra, offering new perspectives on the way these predators stalk, chase and kill. A lone lioness relies on cunning to feed her newborn cubs, whilst a fearless pride tries to take down the biggest prey of all, a giant African elephant. .

programme.title: Predator V Prey T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: A forensic look at how cheetahs hunt their prey, offering new perspectives on the tactics employed by these expert predators when stalking, chasing and bringing down antelope and wildebeest. Following a young cheetah mother over 18-months as she teaches her three cubs the secrets of the hunt.

programme.title: Predator V Prey T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: A forensic look at how Nile crocodiles hunt, offering new perspectives on the patient and precise tactics they use when ambushing migratory herds of wildebeest and zebra that pass through their territories. A male crocodile must target large prey in a bid to survive the harshest time of the year.

programme.title: Predator V Prey T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: A forensic look at how polar bears hunt prey, offering new perspectives on the tactics they use to track, stalk and ambush seals, whales and walruses. We follow a mother fighting to feed her two cubs in the harsh polar extremes, and a young male driven by starvation to tackle enormous prey.

programme.title: Predator V Prey T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: A forensic look at how leopards hunt prey both large and small, offering a new perspective on the way these silent killers stalk and ambush everything from impala to wildebeest and catfish to storks. A female leopard deploys stealth, strength and agility to take down prey on land, in water and from the air.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T21 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Beloved clinic house cat, Tater, falls ill and the team bands together to save him. Charles debuts a new look, Dr. Pol treats a wood-chewing steer, and Dr. Brenda looks after a lab with stomach issues. A nosey Chihuahua eats a poisonous snack, so Dr. Lisa dispenses a messy antidote and Dr. Nicole jumps in to rescue a mama goat in labor.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol T22 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: An ice storm shuts down the clinic and newborn labs are melting hearts. When treacherous weather leaves injured animals in its wake, Dr. Pol and his team slide in to fix busted hips and toe tips. Dr. Lisa handles a demanding delivery while Dr. Brenda impresses by corralling cattle and wrangling racehorses.

programme.title: Lion T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: After a desperate search, Kio and Summer reunite with the brothers — but life on the fringes of the pride’s territory is unforgiving. As Summer struggles to hunt for her inexperienced sons and prepare them for independence, the demands of survival begin to take their toll. When an easy meal proves too tempting to resist. The consequences change Kio’s life forever, forcing him into independence far sooner than expected.

programme.title: Lion T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Against all odds, Kio survives a buffalo attack, but his troubles are far from over. At 12 weeks old, he is the youngest and most vulnerable member of the pride. To have any hope of one day becoming king, he must earn the respect of his older brothers and find his place among them. Just as he is finally able to gain their acceptance, the dry season sets in, and food becomes scarce.
